decisions.reason: The source changes only Big Block prize parameters; the Small Block prize amount, pool, and draw condition remain unchanged.
Changing the Big Block prize amount and draw trigger does not change ticket issuance, independent counters, eligibility since the previous draw, or post-draw reset behavior.
The source does not change random winner selection, ticket weighting, or eligibility rules; it only changes Big Block prize parameters.
The source does not alter royalty enforcement, Big Block as a royalty destination, or the rule that secondary sales create no referral tickets.
The Big Block parameter change does not alter the existing manual prize-collection method.
Big Block tickets and their metadata counter remain in use; the source does not change counter or badge visibility.
The source does not change the referral commission amount, recipient, trigger, or automatic payout mode.
The source does not change the no-referral trigger, random recipient selection, or prize-ticket reward.
The changed Big Block values may be exposed as pool data, but the public unauthenticated access policy and listed public data remain unchanged.
The word 'block' is incidental overlap; the source concerns the Big Block prize mechanism and does not affect Mauritius landing-page access.
The client parameter change does not change the required deployment network or deployment state.
The source does not change email magic-link authentication or its dashboard-access purpose.
